overview.text: The White-lipped Pit Viper is a green, venomous tree viper of South-east Asia, from Nepal to southern China and Indonesia.

size.label: Adults
size.text: Males up to 60 cm and females up to 81 cm long.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar, Thailand, Cambodia, Laos, Vietnam, southern China (with Hong Kong, Macau and Hainan) and Indonesia (Sumatra, Java and the Lesser Sunda Islands).

diet.text: Birds, small frogs and small mammals. Like many tree snakes, it holds on to its prey instead of letting go after biting.

recognise.text: Green pit viper with a pale upper lip.
